features.title: Minimalna zaliha
features.current_state: lib/data/database.dart::PantryItems stores nullable REAL quantity/unit, expiresAt, confirmedAt and sourceShoppingItemId; lib/data/pantry_repository.dart::PantryRepository.receivePurchases is transactional/idempotent locally; lib/domain/shopping_demand.dart::toMicros/normalizeUnit and lib/domain/supply_allocation.dart::Supply.canonicalId/allocateSupply preserve confirmed compatible capacity. No threshold or replenish policy; lib/app/router.dart /pantry is EmptyStateScreen.
proposed_changes: Add household ReplenishmentPolicy(id, ingredientKey, unitGroup, minimumMicros, targetMicros, active); require target >= minimum >= 0.

Build a read-only replenish proposal using canonical confirmed usable stock, unresolved reservations, bought-not-received supply and compatible open shopping coverage. Desired total demand = max(existing recipe demand, target stock gap) under a stated policy, never blindly add recipe demand plus gap. Explicit approval creates a stable replenish source, reused on retry; no automatic purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Stock 200 g, minimum 300 g, target 1000 g produces 800 g proposal; compatible unbought coverage 500 g leaves 300 g additional.
Equality with minimum creates no prompt; unknown stock asks for review; repeated approval creates one source and preserves bought items.
verification: Domain fixtures for threshold equality, two equivalent units, unknown quantity, expired lot, shared purchase/receipt identity and existing shopping.
Repository fake-backend test: approve twice, receive once, reconcile twice; no duplicate source or capacity.
scope_slices: Read-only minimum/target editor and preview with deterministic domain tests.
Approve into current ShoppingRepository contribution/source model; sync policy and source with RLS.
Add pantry low-stock filter and user-controlled reminders only after proposal behavior is stable.

features.title: Zamrznuti gotovi obroci

proposed_changes: Use cooked PantryItems with supplyKind=cooked and CookedBatch metadata (batchId, recipeSnapshot, preparedAt, frozenAt, confirmed portions or mass, thawReminderAt). Do not match cooked food to raw ingredients by name.

Meal entry can draw portions from one batch using CookedBatchAllocation; reserving/reheating never generates raw demand again. Cooking consumes ingredients only after explicit confirmation; recording batch output uses the same operation id.
acceptance_criteria: Cook six portions once, freeze four, reserve two on each of two future meals: cooked available=0 and raw demand occurs once.
Declining notifications or offline operation still allows manual frozenAt/thaw preparation; recipe deletion preserves batch snapshot.
verification: Domain batch conservation fixtures; repository test cooking retry and reserve/cancel/reheat.
Widget test list frozen batches, edit portions, select meal; fake clock notification deny/unavailable test.
scope_slices: Manual cooked-batch creation and listing linked to PantryItems; no automatic ingredient decrement.
Link batch reservations to plan and remove duplicate raw demand in explicit batch mode.
Add optional local thaw reminder capability gate and snapshot-preserving sync.

Repository fixture purchase->receipt->split->expire->reconcile; sync replay and two-device identical operation conflict.

Add lot dates and FEFO proposal while retaining current single-row receipts.
Add optional split/merge with root conservation, unique operation keys and outbox atomicity.

features.title: Brza provera inventara

proposed_changes: Extend PantryRepository confirmQuantity/markEmpty/markUnknown with operation id, clock and expected revision. Known uses micros; empty is confirmed zero; unknown is null with a separate checkedAt and confidence state.

Keep checkedAt distinct from quantityConfirmedAt. Define explicit user-configurable freshness policy rather than silently invalidating old stock. A received purchase marked unknown/empty must suppress bought-item fallback for the same physical root.
acceptance_criteria: Known 250 g -> unknown results in no numeric allocation; empty gives zero; repeating confirmation never increases stock.
With bought 250 g received and then marked empty, 100 g new demand remains 100 g, rather than being covered by the old bought record.
verification: Repository fixtures known/unknown/empty across purchase receipt aliases, stale revision and fake clock.
Widget quick inventory offline, undo explicit correction, phone/wide, text 2x; RLS two households.
scope_slices: Add pure confidence/freshness contract and regression tests for received-root fallback.
Implement repository commands with transactional reconcile and outbox.
Replace pantry placeholder with list and quick confirm editor.

Only confirmed actual bought content becomes supply; surplus may enter pantry once through existing receipt link. Unknown size/dimension mismatch retains exact need and asks for package confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: 750 g need with 500 g package proposes 2 packages/1000 g and 250 g surplus; 1000 g need proposes 2/0 surplus.
100 g pantry plus 2 bought 500 g packs can cover at most 1100 g across plans and preparations; receipt creates no additional capacity; reject zero package.
verification: Integer fixtures 0,1 micro,exact multiples, huge safe bounds, unknown and mass/volume mismatch.
Repository buy actual quantity different from proposal then receive twice, edit plan, preserve purchase history.

Persist proposal separate from frozen purchase provenance; confirm actual bought amount.

Mixed currencies never sum; deposit-only receipt line contributes zero grams to pantry.

features.title: Poravnanje kupovine sa računom

proposed_changes: ReceiptDraft(documentHash, merchantText, purchasedAt, currency, parserVersion, rows) is private and separate from confirmed stock. Row includes source row ordinal, raw label, parsed quantity/unit/price, classification(food/deposit/discount/return), candidate matches and review status.

AI/OCR through AIRouter proposes only. ConfirmReconciliation(operationId, expectedDraftRevision, accepted mappings) posts actual purchased quantities and receipt links, then receives the same physical supply in one transaction/outbox group. Unique household+receiptId+rowId+action prevents retry duplicates; document hash warns about possible duplicate, never auto-merges legitimate identical receipts.

A bought row can span several lots/receipts: use explicit purchase/receipt lines and root conservation (F038). Preserve original demand and frozen purchase history; corrections after confirmation use compensating differences, not delete/recreate. Receipt image private and optional; no automatic public Open Prices upload.

Already marked bought then receipt reconciliation does not add a second1000 g; ambiguous kg/kom/price line stays unposted until reviewed.
Food, deposit, discount, unlisted product and returned item are reviewed separately; declining draft writes no purchase/stock.
verification: Fake AI and malformed OCR fixtures, decimal comma, weighed produce, multipack, duplicate scan, same-content different receipt and mixed units.
Repository atomic failure injection before/after each row and retry; existing bought->received path; concurrent same-operation unique-key race; exact 750/1000/250 fixture.
Widget editable matching preview, rejection/manual rows and private image access; local Supabase two-account RLS, no external API.

Confirm single-line receipt using existing setBought/receive identity and operation id.
Add multiline/split/partial reconciliation and corrections with transactional outbox and concurrency constraints.

Plan-linked servings and later read-only yield comparisons for same recipe version.

features.title: Dostupnost konkretnih proizvoda
features.current_state: No retailer stock adapter in lib/data; OFF product metadata and Open Prices historical observations are external sources, neither is household Supply nor proof of live shelf stock.
proposed_changes: RetailAvailabilityAdapter.probe(country, retailer, branch, fulfillmentSlot) reports supported/unsupported/authRequired/temporarilyUnavailable with capabilities. AvailabilityObservation(productCode, retailerSku, branchId, slot, status[inStock,outOfStock,unknown], observedAt, expiresAt, source, evidence) is cached separately.

Only authorized documented retailer data with actual branch/slot semantics can produce inStock. Price history or OFF stores/countries tags remain metadata; stale result becomes unknown. No Serbian retailer is confirmed supported in this research; ship manual dated observation plus unavailable state until a lawful adapter is verified.
acceptance_criteria: Open Prices price from yesterday yields unknown availability; branch A inStock cannot satisfy branch B or a different slot.
Timeout, unsupported Serbia retailer, missing SKU and expired observation show „Dostupnost nije proverena” with last checked time; household stock and shopping quantities do not change.
verification: Fake adapters for supported, denied, stale, branch mismatch and late/out-of-order response.
Future capability audit: official API terms/endpoint/branch identity/slot semantics, sample freshness SLA and Serbian test branch evidence before enabling retailer.
Widget source/date display and manual observation correction; never use a live retailer in unit tests.
scope_slices: Define availability contract and manual dated observation, default unknown.
Add isolated cache and fake adapter test suite; no production integration claim.
Enable one Serbian retailer only after capability/terms/data validation, with feature flag and expiry policy.

features.title: Ponudi višak hrane

Offer reservation removes offered amount from planner-available capacity without consuming it. Claim/withdraw/expire do not transfer stock. Owner confirms handover -> single transfer-out movement; recipient can independently confirm receipt under a new household root linked by opaque handover reference, not access donor inventory.

First slice private revocable unguessable link to named recipient; no public discovery/location feed. Exact address/contact shared only explicitly; auth/authorization for claiming and atomic single-winner transfer gate required online. Offline supports draft and queued owner correction, not two conflicting successful claims.
acceptance_criteria: Offer300 g from500 g leaves200 g available; withdraw/expire restores500 g; confirmed handover leaves200 g and retry does not subtract again.
Two claimants racing produce one accepted claim; recipient reads no other pantry row; link revocation removes offer access; exact pickup location absent from public payload.
verification: State machine fixtures draft->offered->claimed->handedOver and cancel/expire; reservation conservation and handover retry.
Local backend RLS/public-projection tests for owner, recipient, stranger and expired/revoked token; concurrency test one winner.
Widget offline draft/unavailable claim, explicit owner handover confirmation, unknown allergen data and injected clock pickup expiry.
scope_slices: Private offer draft and local quantity reservation only, no external publish.
Revocable minimal projection and online atomic claim; permission/RLS tests.
Owner-confirmed handover movement and optional independent recipient receipt; no automatic chat/email sent.

inspected_files.finding: License copied unchanged; no repository NOTICE found.

Country/city/name filters for observed locations, not coverage guarantee.
rs/SRB and Currency.RSD are representable; not a count of Serbian products, prices or retailer inventory.

Complete small tagged external-unit mapper copied with dependency. Handles unknowns and alternate spelling; not a pantry quantity conversion engine.
Complete dependency of UnitHelper; copied unchanged.

inspected_files.finding: Study/citation only; no code copied.
Price fields include product_code, currency, date, location, proof and receipt_quantity; duplicate logic uses location/date/currency. These are observations, not stock.
Raw predicted_data, schema_version, status and links to proof/prediction/price are distinct; useful review-before-confirmation pattern, not automatic pantry receipt.

unknowns: Serbian product/package/name coverage and recent RSD/location price counts were NOT measured; no public production API calls or retailer production checks were made. SDK enum support is not local market support.

Physical root/lot split representation and unique receipt-line keys require integration review with stream D before any implementation; existing samePhysicalAs canonical dedupe cannot represent arbitrary split children unchanged.
Cross-device stock compare-and-set/atomic command application is a new foundation gate; local transaction/outbox alone does not ensure server-side no overspend.
Receipt OCR model quality for Serbian fiscal receipts, numeral formatting and multipack labels is unknown; manual review is mandatory and OCR remains optional.
Pantry confirmedAt currently has no age threshold; decide user-visible freshness policy rather than silently inventing one.
Data/image licensing and any derived database redistribution need explicit implementation-stage review; code license is not dataset license.
No upstream software/install scripts, Flutter tests or backend tests were run. Only output JSON/hash/coverage checks described in validation were performed.
